description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/heat_2d_varcoeff_x_zero_flux.esm (model Heat, test mms_varcoeff_2d_x_zero_flux_decay) at the problem's default resolution (NX=64, NY edge-bound to 8) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the conservative finite-volume variable-coefficient 2-D Laplacian rule varcoeff_laplacian_x_zero_flux_bc lowering the compound D(k*D(u,x),x) over the full 2-D field. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Preemptively excluded, mirroring the same-operator sibling heat_1d_varcoeff_zero_flux: earthsci-ast-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard and wedges (drives dt->0 without terminating) on this stiff variable-coefficient large-AST RHS. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
